newsitem.title: USA: TCI stake held by Shaw group.
newsitem.headline: TCI stake held by Shaw group.

text.p: A group led by D.E. Shaw and Co Inc said Friday it holds a 5.8 percent stake in TCI Communications Inc or 265,000 cumulative exchangeable preferred stock series A.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 85,000 common shares up until January 8 at prices ranging from $40.25 to $40.935 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes, the filing said.
TCI Communications is a subsidiary of Tele-Communications Inc.
